repo.description:
## Impact

The Read/Write Files from Disk node evaluated the File(s) Selector glob pattern on the main event loop with no time limit. A selector with many wildcards compiles to a regular expression with exponential backtracking. A member who can create and run workflows can submit such a pattern and block the n8n process, so the UI, API, webhooks and health checks stop responding until the process is restarted.

## Patches

The issue has been fixed in n8n versions 1.123.85, 2.44.1, and 2.43.5. Users should upgrade to one of these versions or later to remediate the vulnerability.

## Workarounds

If upgrading is not immediately possible, administrators should consider the following temporary mitigations:
- Restrict n8n instance access to fully trusted users only.
- Disable the Read/Write Files node by adding `n8n-nodes-base.readWriteFile` to the `NODES_EXCLUDE` environment variable if it is not required.
- Audit existing workflows for Read/Write Files nodes with unusual File(s) Selector values and remove or correct them.

These workarounds do not fully remediate the risk and should only be used as short-term mitigation measures.
repo.summary: Read/Write Files Node Glob Pattern Causes Unbounded Event-Loop Block
